title: Multi-factor authentication
abstract: Multi-factor authentication reduces account compromise by adding an independent verification step.

title: Access control
abstract: Role-based access control limits access to approved resources and protects sensitive information.

title: Security logging
abstract: Security logging records authentication events and supports incident investigation.

title: Patch management
abstract: Patch management reduces exposure to known vulnerabilities and supports secure system maintenance.

title: Incident response
abstract: Incident response follows the documented escalation process and preserves evidence for investigation.

title: Data encryption
abstract: Data encryption protects confidential records during storage and transmission.

title: Phishing awareness
abstract: Phishing awareness training helps users identify suspicious messages and reduces credential theft.

title: Network segmentation
abstract: Network segmentation limits lateral movement between sensitive systems and general user networks.

title: Backup recovery
abstract: Backup recovery requires periodic restoration tests and protects service continuity after data loss.

title: Least privilege
abstract: Least privilege limits each account to the resources required for its approved tasks.

title: Vulnerability scanning
abstract: Vulnerability scanning identifies exposed services and supports prioritised remediation.

title: Audit trails
abstract: Audit trails maintain a history of document changes and support accountability.
